github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use a Conventional Commits subject (feat:, fix:, test:, docs:, chore:, ci:, refactor:) in the imperative mood, under 72 characters. Add a short body only when the reason is not obvious. Never mention credentials, hostnames, or patient data.

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: Summarize what changed and why, list the checks that were run (pnpm verify, and test:e2e or dist on Windows when relevant), and call out any change that still needs the Windows CI jobs.
